standard_prerequisites.name: Ordered r-patterns, the pattern family of an ordered partition, P-cliques and their sizes, and the notion of a lambda-partite collection
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's preliminaries (source lines 225-281) and in the author's definition at source lines 289-291
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes every object of the statement: the collection, its pattern family and the clique-size bounds.

core_obligations: Set up the dichotomy: the proposition distinguishes the case in which the collection contains a large interval-wise lambda-partite sub-collection from the case in which it contains a large lambda-prime-partite sub-collection for some coarser partition, and the proof works with the numbers M_{lambda-prime} attached to the coarser partitions (proof lines 393-415).

The multi-dimensional Erdos-Szekeres input: the proof appeals to the author's theorems on monotone sequences and on interval-wise partite collections, which is where the pigeonhole over the pattern family enters (proof lines 393-415).

The two counting lemmas: the author's attribution to the classical results of Caro and of Wei supplies the clique-size bounds for the pattern family, which is what turns the pigeonhole into the dichotomy of the statement (proof lines 393-415).
Conclusion: one of the two alternatives must occur, with the explicit sizes stated in the proposition (proof lines 393-415).
proof_roadmap: 本命题是二择一：要么存在大的 interval-wise lambda-partite 子集族，要么存在某个更粗划分 lambda' 的大的 lambda'-partite 子集族。
证明用作者的多维 Erdős–Szekeres 定理与区间划分的 pigeonhole，结合 Caro 与 Wei 的团大小界，把计数逼成两个择一之一。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the dichotomy that drives the main induction of the paper (author proposition at source lines 381-387, label prop-two-options): a lambda-partite collection with bounded pattern-clique sizes either contains a large interval-wise lambda-partite sub-collection or a large lambda-prime-partite one for some coarser partition. The proof (source lines 393-415) is the author's own, headed Proof of Proposition prop-two-options, and it is the step in which the multi-dimensional Erdos-Szekeres theorem, the interval-wise partite lemma and the clique-size bounds of Caro and Wei are combined through a pigeonhole over the pattern family; the two explicit sizes of the alternatives come from that combination. The proposition is one of the two inputs of the induction theorem. H2.
